sentences.text: You’re going from buoy one to bell two.
Walking the parallel rulers to the rose gives a true course of zero six eight.
The dividers span five point three minutes on the latitude scale beside the line, so the distance is five point three nautical miles.
At twelve knots, the time is sixty times five point three, divided by twelve, about twenty-six and a half minutes.
Departing at nine hundred, you’ll arrive at about nine twenty-seven.
